Name: Submissions
Summary: Lets visitors send in news with a title, a text and an optional image. Editors review the proposals and accept one as a draft post or reject it.
Guide:
Each instance feeds one Publishing instance: an accepted proposal becomes an unpublished post there, which editors finish and publish as usual. Use one instance per stream that takes tips from visitors.

Add it to the site

app.Use(
    publishing.Module("news", "News"),
    submissions.Module("tips", "Tips", "news"),
)

The key (tips) is used in the admin, the form action and the template functions, and must be unique on the site. The title (Tips) is what editors see in the admin and the page editor. The third argument is the key of the Publishing instance that accepted proposals go to; add that instance as well. It cannot be empty or the instance's own key.

Place it on a page

In the admin, open a page and choose the instance under Shows on this page. The page shows the proposal form from tips/form.gohtml, or submissions/form.gohtml for every instance without a design of its own. Other addresses below the page get the site's 404 page. Generate a working starting point, with labels and every result message:

task templates -- tips

A minimal form:

{{/* @dot github.com/donseba/go-webthings/modules/submissions.FormView */}}
<h1>{{.Title}}</h1>

<section id="{{.Key}}">
    {{if eq .Result "sent"}}
        <p>Thank you! The editors will read your proposal.</p>
    {{else}}
        {{if eq .Result "invalid"}}<p>Please fill in every field. Images are JPEG, PNG or GIF up to {{.MaxImageMB}} MB.</p>{{end}}
        {{if eq .Result "throttled"}}<p>You sent several proposals already. Please try again later.</p>{{end}}

        {{form_open .Form}}
            {{form_field .Form "name" nil}}
            {{form_field .Form "email" nil}}
            {{form_field .Form "title" nil}}
            {{form_field .Form "text" nil}}
            {{form_field .Form "image" nil}}
            <button>Send</button>
        {{form_close}}
    {{end}}
</section>

.Form is the form: form_open writes the form tag, posting to .Action as multipart/form-data because of the image, with the spam trap and the page to return to, the element whose id is .Key, the instance key. form_field renders one of its fields by its key, with its label and limits, such as the image's accept, translated with the site's translations and in the site's form theme; the ids start with the key, such as tips-title. See Template functions.

Show the form anywhere

The same form works in any template, for example in a sidebar, with three template functions: submitInput is the form, submitURL the address it posts to and submitResult the result of the visitor's last post. The form returns the visitor to the element whose id is the instance key:

<aside id="tips">
    {{if eq (submitResult "tips") "sent"}}
        <p>Thank you for your tip!</p>
    {{else}}
        {{with submitInput "tips"}}
            {{form_open .}}
                {{form_field . "name" nil}}
                {{form_field . "email" nil}}
                {{form_field . "title" nil}}
                {{form_field . "text" nil}}
                {{form_field . "image" nil}}
                <button>Send</button>
            {{form_close}}
        {{end}}
    {{end}}
</aside>

Inputs written by hand with the names of the fields below work too.

Visitors

The form posts the fields of submissions.ProposalInput to /_/tips/submit as multipart/form-data, because of the image; a form without an image field may be sent url-encoded.

Field
name one line, up to 200 characters
email a valid e-mail address
title one line, up to 200 characters
text plain text or Markdown, up to 20000 characters
image optional: JPEG, PNG or GIF up to 5 MB, sent as one of those types or with a .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .gif name, and recognised by its content

The visitor returns to the form's page with ?tips=sent, ?tips=invalid when a field is missing or wrong, or ?tips=throttled after more than five proposals in an hour from the same IP address (list a reverse proxy in Config.TrustedProxies). Posts that fill in the spam trap that form_open adds are answered with sent and dropped. Only a proposal that was stored makes the site's output cache render the pages again; see Modules and the output cache.

With invalid, the form shows the visitor's name, address, title and text again, with a message in the page's language at each field to correct; the image is not kept, so the visitor chooses it again. form_field does this without a change to the template; inputs written by hand do not. See A post with mistakes. A proposal that cannot be saved, such as when the database cannot be reached, gets the site's error page, 500.gohtml, also with HTMX.

A proposal keeps the language of the page the form was on. Its image goes into the media library right away and cannot be deleted there until the proposal is deleted for good.

In the admin

Each instance has its own section (/admin/tips; /admin is the default admin path) with a badge that counts the new proposals. The list shows the new proposals, newest first, with dates in the site's timezone; filters switch to the accepted, the rejected or all proposals.

A proposal shows its text, image, sender, e-mail address and language. Editors with the right to publish in the instance can:

  • Accept as draft post: this creates an unpublished post in news, in the proposal's language, with its title, its text as Markdown and its image as the post's image, dated today. The post's history names the sender. Open draft post leads to it. A rejected proposal can still be accepted.
  • Reject a new proposal.

Move to trash moves a proposal to the trash, where it can be restored or deleted for good; it needs the delete right. Deleting it for good moves its image to the media library's trash too, unless the proposal was accepted or other content uses the image.

Under Settings, editors who may edit the instance set the address that receives new proposals, and whether senders hear from the site. Other editors do not see the settings.

E-mail

Mail Sent to When
notify the notification address, in the admin's language for every new proposal
received the sender, in the proposal's language after sending, with Confirm receipt to submitters on
accepted, rejected the sender, in the proposal's language when an editor decides, with Tell submitters when their proposal is accepted or rejected on

The notification holds the text, a link to the image if there is one, and a link to the proposal in the admin; replying to it answers the sender. Without a notification address no one is notified, and both options for senders are off until editors switch them on. A theme replaces the texts with mail/tips/<name>.gohtml or mail/submissions/<name>.gohtml.

From Go

submissions.Of(app, "tips") returns the instance once the app has started:

tips := submissions.Of(app, "tips")

waiting, err := tips.Count(ctx, submissions.StatusNew)

Create stores a proposal (an image must already be in the media library), List and Get read proposals, Accept and Reject decide as the admin does, and Delete, Undelete and Purge move a proposal to the trash, bring it back or remove it for good. These calls send no e-mail.

Related modules

  • Publishing holds the posts that accepted proposals become.
  • Forms collects messages that do not become posts, such as a contact form.

SQL.Name: postgres
SQL.SQL:
-- Visitors' proposals for a news item. media_id is the uploaded image, if any;
-- post_id is the draft post an accepted proposal became. Status is new,
-- accepted or rejected; decided_by is the editor who accepted or rejected it.
-- Deleting moves a proposal to the trash (deleted_at); its post stays.
CREATE TABLE wt_submission (
    id         UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    instance   VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    name       VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    email      VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL,
    title      VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    body       TEXT NOT NULL,
    media_id   UUID,
    locale     VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL,
    status     VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
    post_id    UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_by UUID,
    deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    deleted_by UUID,
    decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    decided_by UUID
);

CREATE INDEX wt_submission_instance ON wt_submission (instance, status, created_at);

-- Settings per instance: who is notified, and whether submitters get a
-- confirmation and hear about the decision. The texts of the mails are mail
-- templates (see package submissions).
CREATE TABLE wt_submission_setting (
    instance      VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    notify        VARCHAR(254) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    confirm_mail  BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    decision_mail BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_by    UUID
);

Types.Doc: DetailView is the data of templates/admin/detail.gohtml: one proposal with the buttons to accept or reject it.

type DetailView struct {
	Title   string
	BackURL string
	Name    string
	Email   string
	Subject string
	Body    string
	// ImageURL is empty without an image.
	ImageURL string
	Locale   string
	Date     string
	Status   string
	// Decided is when and by whom the submission was accepted or rejected.
	Decided   string
	DecidedBy string
	// PostURL opens the draft post of an accepted submission.
	PostURL string
	Accept  *form.RenderModel
	Reject  *form.RenderModel

}

Types.Name: Proposal
ProposalInput
Types.Doc: ProposalInput is the form a visitor posts to /_/<key>/submit: a name, an e-mail address, a title, the text and optionally an image. Themes render its fields with form_field, with their limits (FormView.Form), or write inputs with these names; a form with the image is sent as multipart/form-data.
Types.Decl:
type ProposalInput struct {
	Name  string                `form:"input,text"  name:"name"  label:"Name"           required:"true" maxLength:"200"   line:"true" autocomplete:"name"`
	Email string                `form:"input,email" name:"email" label:"E-mail address" required:"true" maxLength:"254"               autocomplete:"email" validate:"mail"`
	Title string                `form:"input,text"  name:"title" label:"Title"          required:"true" maxLength:"200"   line:"true"`
	Text  string                `form:"textarea"    name:"text"  label:"Text"           required:"true" maxLength:"20000"`
	Image *multipart.FileHeader `form:"input,file"  name:"image" label:"Image"                                                                                             accept:"image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif" maxSize:"5MB"`
}
